name: Shadow Pennant rank 2 is in the Heretic tab, not General
contract: Issue #11505. Shadow Pennant rank 2 (525307) had no SkillLineAbility row, so the client filed it under General.
The talent (CharacterAdvancement 30522) shares Tab 66 with Blade of Yogg-Saron, in SkillLine 90 (Heretic)
through row 24171; rank 1 (706926) is never displayed. Row 843, a duplicate of row 12781 (spell 1499) that
differs only in MinSkillLineRank, is repurposed for 525307 at SkillLine 90, and the client patch streams that
row after the spell is learned.

steps.label: CONTROL: Blade of Yogg-Saron rank 1 shares Tab 66 in the Heretic line
CONTROL: row 843's old spell keeps its line through the twin row
the row follows the learn announcement
the client patch carries SkillLine 90 for rank 2
